name: imagine
description: An image editor that is an Agent Protocol v1 server. Editing is modelled as the protocol already models work: a project is a workspace, an edit session is a task, one operation — generate, edit, upscale — is a step, and the image that comes back is that task's artifact. Because AP steps are allowed to be asynchronous, every operation runs on a background worker and the client polls: a generation that takes ninety seconds does not hold a socket open, the console renders the queue, and any Agent Protocol client — including the ones already in this fleet — can drive the whole editor without knowing anything about it beyond the protocol. Images are content-addressed by the SHA-256 of their own bytes and every artifact records the image it came from, so a project is not a folder of files but the DAG of edits that produced them: what was generated, what was edited into what, with which prompt, on which model. Two providers sit behind one operation table — Venice (generate, edit, upscale) and OpenRouter (generate, edit) — resolved per operation by what the box actually has a key for, so a missing key narrows the menu instead of breaking the module. Keys are read from the fleet's own stores (the venice and model.openrouter modules) rather than kept here.
state: ~/.mod/imagine — blobs/ (content-addressed images), projects.json, tasks.json, owner.json, server.secret

venice.key: the venice module's api_key(), or VENICE_API_KEY

openrouter.key: the model.openrouter module's api_key(), or OPENROUTER_API_KEY

ops.edit: an image + a prompt → the edited image
ops.upscale: an image + a scale → the larger image
